Terms of Use

Live Moment: Weather Wallpaper · Last updated: 2 October 2026

These terms are the agreement between you and Yunus Emre Sarı ("we", "us") for the Live Moment: Weather Wallpaper app ("Live Moment", "the app"). By using the app you accept them. If you do not accept them, please do not use the app. Please read them together with the Privacy Policy and the Acceptable Use Policy, which form part of this agreement.

The short version

  • You must be at least 18. The app is not meant for anyone under 18.
  • Only upload photos you have the right to use, of people who agreed. Only upload a photo of a child if you are that child's parent or legal guardian.
  • Your photos are sent to third-party AI providers, possibly outside your country. See the Privacy Policy.

  • Purchases go through Google Play.

1. What Live Moment does

Live Moment turns a photo you choose into animated wallpapers for your Android phone, using AI. Live Weather and Live Weather Plus can switch the wallpaper with the weather and the time of day. You can also make single wallpapers. Features, plans and prices can change over time.

2. Who can use it

  • You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of legal majority where you live if that is higher, and able to enter into a binding contract.
  • The app is not directed at, or meant to be used by, anyone under 18. The terms of some of the AI models we use also require this.
  • You need an Android device and an account (sign in with an email link or with Google). Keep your sign-in secure. You are responsible for what happens under your account.

3. Your photos and your promises

You keep ownership of your photos. By choosing a photo and starting a creation, you promise that:

  • you own the photo or have the right to use it, and to let us and our AI providers process it as described in the Privacy Policy;
  • everyone who can be recognised in the photo has agreed, including to their image being sent to third-party AI providers, which may be outside your country;
  • if a child is shown, you are that child's parent or legal guardian and you agree on the child's behalf;
  • the photo does not break the law or the Acceptable Use Policy, and does not infringe anyone's copyright, privacy or other rights.

Do not upload photos of other people's children, or of people who have not agreed. You are responsible for the photos you upload and for how you use and share the results. If a person shown in a photo asks us to remove it, we may delete it and may suspend the account that uploaded it.

5. AI providers and how the service works

The app depends on third-party AI providers and on Google Cloud, Firebase and Google Play. We can change providers or models at any time. Results are different each time, can contain mistakes such as distorted faces or details, and may not look like the people in your photo. Our AI provider is Pixazo, which runs models from other developers, for example OpenAI's GPT Image. Some of these developers' rules apply to you too: in particular you must not use the app in a way that breaks OpenAI's Usage Policies. A provider may refuse a photo or block a result under its safety rules, and a creation can fail. A creation that fails or is refused is normally not counted against your allowance. We do not guarantee that the service will always be available.

  • One-time packs are used up as you create wallpapers.
  • Refunds are handled by Google Play under its policies. Nothing in these terms limits refund or withdrawal rights that you have under mandatory consumer law.
  • Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription or refund a purchase. Cancel in Google Play first.

We may do this if we reasonably believe someone has broken these terms or the Acceptable Use Policy, if the law or an AI provider requires it, or to protect people or our systems. If we close an account because of your breach, we may refuse a refund where the law allows.

You can stop using the app and delete your account at any time (Profile → Account → Delete account, or see account deletion).
